name: 8mm Video Consumer Camcorder
description: Sony Video8 / Hi8 camcorder format. 8mm cassette, smaller and lighter than VHS, used heavily in home video from 1985 onward. Similar quality to VHS but different mechanical noise profile.
aesthetic_notes: 8mm has a more intimate, home-video feel. The dropout noise clusters are slightly finer than VHS due to the smaller tape geometry. Often associated with birthday parties, holidays, family events — the dominant consumer nostalgia format.
